messages.author: 8caf9e9fc35f0eed
messages.subject: Re: Mac OS X, Snow Leopard: Report fails
parts:
It appears from the error message that you have not installed package:Hmisc. It has a function named 'describe'. It appears that odfWeave was going to use that function and even attempted to automagically load the package but failed. At least that is how I read the error trail.

-- 
David.
